001import javax.swing.JFrame;
002import javax.swing.JTextField;
003import javax.swing.JTextArea;
004import javax.swing.JLabel;
005import javax.swing.ImageIcon;
006import javax.swing.JScrollPane;
007import javax.swing.JPanel;
008import javax.swing.JButton;
009import java.awt.Dimension;
010import java.awt.BorderLayout;
011import java.awt.event.ActionListener;
012import java.awt.event.WindowAdapter;
013import java.awt.event.WindowEvent;
014import java.awt.event.ActionEvent;
015import java.net.URL;
016import java.awt.image.*;
017
018/**
019 * This class implements a simple graphical user interface with a 
020 * text entry area, a text output area and an optional image.
021 * 
022 * @author Michael Kolling
023 * @version 1.0 (Jan 2003) DB edited (2023)
024 */
025public class UserInterface implements ActionListener
026{
027    private GameEngine aEngine;
028    private JFrame     aMyFrame;
029    private JTextField aEntryField;
030    private JTextArea  aLog;
031    private JLabel     aImage;
032    private JButton    aButton;
033
034    /**
035     * Construct a UserInterface. As a parameter, a Game Engine
036     * (an object processing and executing the game commands) is
037     * needed.
038     * 
039     * @param pGameEngine  The GameEngine object implementing the game logic.
040     */
041    public UserInterface( final GameEngine pGameEngine )
042    {
043        this.aEngine = pGameEngine;
044        this.createGUI();
045    } // UserInterface(.)
046
047    /**
048     * Print out some text into the text area.
049     * 
050     * @param pText String to be printed
051     */
052    public void print( final String pText )
053    {
054        this.aLog.append( pText );
055        this.aLog.setCaretPosition( this.aLog.getDocument().getLength() );
056    } // print(.)
057
058    /**
059     * Print out some text into the text area, followed by a line break.
060     */
061    public void println( final String pText )
062    {
063        this.print( pText + "\n" );
064    } // println(.)
065
066    /**
067     * Show an image file in the interface.
068     */
069    public void showImage( final String pImageName )
070    {
071        String vImagePath = "" + pImageName; // to change the directory
072        URL vImageURL = this.getClass().getClassLoader().getResource( vImagePath );
073        if ( vImageURL == null )
074            System.out.println( "Image not found : " + vImagePath );
075        else {
076            ImageIcon vIcon = new ImageIcon( vImageURL );
077            this.aImage.setIcon( vIcon );
078            this.aMyFrame.pack();
079        }
080    } // showImage(.)
081
082    /**
083     * Enable or disable input in the entry field.
084     */
085    public void enable( final boolean pOnOff )
086    {
087        this.aEntryField.setEditable( pOnOff ); // enable/disable
088        if ( pOnOff ) { // enable
089            this.aEntryField.getCaret().setBlinkRate( 500 ); // cursor blink
090            this.aEntryField.addActionListener( this ); // reacts to entry
091        }
092        else { // disable
093            this.aEntryField.getCaret().setBlinkRate( 0 ); // cursor won't blink
094            this.aEntryField.removeActionListener( this ); // won't react to entry
095        }
096    } // enable(.)
097
098    /**
099     * Set up graphical user interface.
100     */
101    private void createGUI()
102    {
103        this.aMyFrame = new JFrame( "President Evil" ); // window name
104        this.aEntryField = new JTextField( 34 );
105
106        this.aLog = new JTextArea();
107        this.aLog.setEditable( false );
108        JScrollPane vListScroller = new JScrollPane( this.aLog );
109        vListScroller.setPreferredSize( new Dimension(200, 200) );
110        vListScroller.setMinimumSize( new Dimension(100,100) );
111
112        this.aImage = new JLabel();
113        
114        // add button 
115        this.aButton = new JButton("look");
116        
117        JPanel vPanel = new JPanel();
118        vPanel.setLayout( new BorderLayout() ); // ==> only five places
119        vPanel.add( this.aImage, BorderLayout.NORTH );
120        vPanel.add( vListScroller, BorderLayout.CENTER );
121        vPanel.add( this.aEntryField, BorderLayout.SOUTH );
122        vPanel.add( this.aButton, BorderLayout.EAST );
123
124        this.aMyFrame.getContentPane().add( vPanel, BorderLayout.CENTER );
125
126        // add some event listeners to some components
127        this.aEntryField.addActionListener( this );
128        this.aButton.addActionListener( this );
129
130
131        // to end program when window is closed
132        this.aMyFrame.addWindowListener(
133            new WindowAdapter() { // anonymous class
134                @Override public void windowClosing(final WindowEvent pE)
135                {
136                    System.exit(0);
137                }
138        } );
139
140        this.aMyFrame.pack();
141        this.aMyFrame.setVisible( true );
142        this.aEntryField.requestFocus();
143    } // createGUI()
144
145    /**
146     * Actionlistener interface for entry textfield.
147     */
148    @Override public void actionPerformed( final ActionEvent pE ) 
149    {
150        if (pE.getActionCommand() == "look") this.aEngine.interpretCommand( "look");
151        else this.processCommand(); // never suppress this line
152    } // actionPerformed(.)
153
154    /**
155     * A command has been entered in the entry field.  
156     * Read the command and do whatever is necessary to process it.
157     */
158    private void processCommand()
159    {
160        String vInput = this.aEntryField.getText();
161        this.aEntryField.setText( "" );
162
163        this.aEngine.interpretCommand( vInput );
164    } // processCommand()
165} // UserInterface
